name: astano-backend
description: Astano backend — Express 5 + Prisma + PostgreSQL, modular, multi-locale (en primary, de secondary).
//overrides: htmlparser2 is pinned to the last version that still ships a CommonJS
build. sanitize-html is CommonJS and does require('htmlparser2'); v11
dropped the CJS entry, so on any runtime that cannot require() an ES
module that call throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM and takes the whole app down at
load. Node 22.12+ can require(esm), which is why this never appeared in
development or on Render — but Vercel's loader cannot, and every request
v10 is `type: module` with `main: ./dist/commonjs/index.js`: both formats,
same parser. Remove the pin once sanitize-html no longer require()s it.
//engines: 22, not 24, because a host that cannot offer 24 does not fail loudly — it
picks a version of its own and builds anyway, and the mismatch only shows
up at runtime. Nothing here needs 24: the deployed bundle is emitted for
node20, and 22 is where require(esm) and the test runner's flags land.
Render and the VPS run 24 regardless; this is a floor, not a target.
